positive.point: Customers appreciate when Dashers deliver food in person and engage in friendly interactions, which can lead to generous tips.
Some customers are considerate about tipping extra during bad weather, showing appreciation for Dashers working in difficult conditions.
Customers value Dashers who are quick to resolve issues, such as mixed-up orders, and reward them with extra tips and high ratings.
Short delivery distances are appreciated by Dashers, especially when customers tip well for the convenience.
Some customers are willing to give additional feedback and recognition for exceptional service, beyond just tipping.

negative.point: Customers and Dashers express frustration over fake tipping promises, where customers claim they will tip after delivery but do not follow through.
Bundled orders often lead to cold food deliveries, and customers are frustrated by the lack of control over this process.
Dashers are frustrated with low or no tips, especially when delivering to apartment dwellers who often do not tip and provide poor delivery instructions.
Some Dashers feel that asking for additional tips can backfire, as it may lead to customers canceling planned extra tips.
There is a perception that delivery fees and markups are high, leading to customer dissatisfaction and lower tips.
